mission: SNKRDUNK facts after approve-snkr-batch (owner 'ok' 2026-11-03): 12 of the 208 new mappings were refused on their first check with release_name_mismatch (page shows a BOX封入特典 product), and the 37 new discovery listings show proposals 'none' or 'release_unresolved' in snkrdunk-coverage-gap. snkrdunk-quarantine's per-item rows exceed the summary budget, so this compact diagnostic lists the batch outcome by state/outcome/availability/reason, each refused batch item with its listing and stored title, and each candidate created since 2026-11-02 10:00Z with its stored set code, rarity, title and current proposal. Also pins yuyu_reader_component to #256's merge (6c65fa4b), which delivered the nine shards.
